name: Steel Specialties
old_description: provides commercial and industrial fabricated steel components to meet the requirements of our clients in a timely, quality driven, and cost effective manner.  Our best testimony is the continued repeat customer satisfaction that has driven our success since 2006.  If your fabrication projects have demanding schedules and are quality driven then Steel Specialties should be your fabricator of choice.
about:
Steel Specialties, LLC was established in 2006 by Greg Pendergrass and Randy Cunningham in Dunbar, West Virginia. The privately held company later added Brian Cunningham as Operations Manager, bringing together a team with over 100 years of combined steel fabrication experience. In 2016, the firm acquired a 33,000-square-foot facility in Point Pleasant, WV, which now serves as its headquarters alongside the original Dunbar operations.

The company operates a total of 47,700 square feet under roof dedicated to steel fabrication. Its services span structural steel fabrication (columns, beams, trusses, tube frames, floor grating, checkered plate, anchor bolts), custom handrail, ladder, and walkway systems (pipe handrail, bar and rod handrail, caged ladders, platforms), specialty equipment fabrication (belt conveyors, screw conveyors, sampling systems, processing equipment, feeders), and chutework fabrication in mild steel, stainless steel, AR-lined, and ceramic-lined configurations. In-house capabilities also include blasting and painting (with a roto blast machine), engineering detailing in 2D AutoCAD or 3D SolidWorks, and galvanizing coordinated through regional hot-dip facilities.

Steel Specialties serves commercial and industrial clients across the Tri-State Area and globally. Its fabricated components are used in material handling, processing, and structural applications for industries such as power generation, mining, chemical processing, and general manufacturing. The company emphasizes repeat customer satisfaction driven by demanding schedules and quality requirements.

The firm’s stated mission is to provide fabricated products that meet or exceed client requirements by following industry standards such as ISO, ASTM, and AISC. It differentiates itself by offering a “one-stop shop” through integrated detailing, fabrication, blasting, painting, and galvanizing services, allowing clients to consolidate subcontracts.
